questions.prompt: The product development team were ____ that the competition would produce a similar product and get it on the market before they did.
questions.explanation: Sau were cần tính từ anxious mô tả trạng thái lo lắng rằng đối thủ sẽ ra sản phẩm trước.

questions.prompt: The designer made the ____ that people are attracted to boxes in primary colors.
questions.explanation: Made the assumption that... là cụm đưa ra giả định rằng; assumption là danh từ sau the.

questions.prompt: The ____ model of the new car drew attention wherever it was shown.
questions.explanation: Experimental là tính từ bổ nghĩa model, chỉ mẫu xe thử nghiệm.

questions.prompt: Our team came up with the most ____ solution to the problem.
questions.explanation: Most logical solution cần tính từ logical: giải pháp hợp lý nhất do nhóm đề xuất.

questions.prompt: The new employee accepted ____ for not discovering a trademarked toy exactly like his own company's.
questions.explanation: Accept responsibility for là nhận trách nhiệm về việc gì; sau accepted cần danh từ responsibility.

questions.prompt: Mr. Oh did not give the project adequate ____ and the product never made it to market.
questions.explanation: Adequate supervision là sự giám sát đầy đủ; supervision là danh từ chỉ hoạt động, không phải người supervisor.

readingPassage:
In order to stay competitive in today's market, companies must continually work to develop new products. Through
[16] ____ research, a company can ascertain what consumers are interested in buying. Then products that match those
interests can be developed. Nothing should [17] ____ about consumer interests. Product developers need [18] ____ all
the data carefully before spending money on a new product. This is only logical. Consumers will buy products that
meet their needs and desires. The money and effort spent on market research will be repaid many times over by a
product that sells well.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (16).
questions.explanation: Systematic là tính từ bổ nghĩa research: nghiên cứu có hệ thống giúp xác định nhu cầu khách hàng.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (17).
questions.explanation: Nothing should be assumed là cấu trúc bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: không nên tự giả định về sở thích người tiêu dùng.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (18).
questions.explanation: Need to examine là cấu trúc cần làm gì; nhà phát triển phải xem xét dữ liệu trước khi chi tiền.

readingPassage:
February 12, 20—
Kathleen Hollinger
Product Development Department
New Age Systems, Inc.
475 Cutter Avenue
Sellingham, WA 90876
Dear Ms. Hollinger,
I understand that the company has an opening in the
Product Development Department. I am interested
in applying for this position. I have been working for
New Age Systems for close to a decade. Currently I
am a research assistant in the Marketing Department.
During my time at New Age Systems, I have worked
in several departments at the company and have had
the opportunity to learn a great deal about its work. I
feel that I am now ready to assume the responsibilities
of a higher level position. I am anxious to speak with
you about working in the Product Development
Department. Thank you for your attention. I look forward to hearing from you.
Sincerely,
Dean Ayers
February 16, 20—
Dean Ayers
Marketing Department
New Age Systems, Inc.
475 Cutter Avenue
Sellingham, WA 90876
Dear Mr. Ayers,
Thank you for your letter expressing interest in applying for the position in the Product Development
Department. Unfortunately, the position you are
interested in has already been filled. However, I have
communicated with your supervisor, and he speaks
very highly of you. I have also examined your work
record. It is clear that you would be a good asset to
our department. I expect that we will have another
opening before the end of this year. As soon as I have
ascertained the availability of that position, I will be in
contact with you. I look forward to meeting with you
in the near future.
Sincerely,
Kathleen Hollinger
Manager, Product Development Department

questions.prompt: How long has Mr. Ayers worked for New Age Systems, Inc.?
questions.explanation: Close to a decade nghĩa là gần một thập kỷ, tức gần mười năm chứ chưa đúng mười năm.

questions.prompt: What job does Mr. Ayers have now?
questions.explanation: Ông viết Currently I am a research assistant in the Marketing Department, xác định công việc hiện tại.

choiceTexts.B: Ask Mr. Ayers to supervise a project.
choiceTexts.C: Tell Mr. Ayers when a position becomes available.
choiceTexts.D: Send Mr. Ayers a copy of his work record.

questions.explanation: Vị trí đã được tuyển nhưng Hollinger hứa liên hệ ngay khi xác định có vị trí khác còn trống.

questions.prompt: The word assume in the first letter is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Assume the responsibilities nghĩa là nhận/lãnh trách nhiệm, nên take là từ gần nghĩa trong ngữ cảnh này.

questions.prompt: The word examined is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Examined your work record nghĩa là đã xem xét hồ sơ công việc, tương đương looked at.
